rule: Definition control first: make the 16 a comparable dataset. Remaining 24 = controlled backlog.

demands.name: identical_metric_definitions
demands.question: Do all 16 bound systems use identical metric/panel definitions per shared domain?

demands.name: compatible_time_periods
demands.question: Are time periods explicit, non-blended, and marked comparable vs non-comparable?

demands.name: identical_geography_rules
demands.question: Does every claim state US vs Arkansas vs county without national-to-local implication?

demands.name: missing_data_and_provenance
demands.question: Is missing data left missing, with source provenance retained on every critical number?

demands.name: comparable_markers_and_verdicts
demands.question: Are comparable/non-comparable markers and for/against/NEE vocabulary consistent across the 16?

demands.name: controlled_backlog_gate
demands.question: Are the remaining 24 systems gated behind written-argument need rather than completeness optics?
